content: We believe, the effect of changing the profile attribute in accordance with Prime Minister's campaign is an example of inorganic behavior contagion BIBREF6, BIBREF9. The authors in BIBREF6 argue that opinion diffuses easily in a network if it comes from opinion leaders who are considered to be users with a very high number of followers. We see a similar behavior contagion in our dataset with respect to the Chowkidar movement.
